four-wheeled: of or relating to vehicles with four wheels
fourfold: four times as great or many
fourhanded: (of card games) involving or requiring four players
fourth-year: used of the fourth and final year in United States high school or college
for_a_song: for a relatively small amount of money
for_certain: definitely or positively (`sure' is sometimes used informally for `surely')
for_dear_life: as though your life was at stake
for_each_one: to or from every one of two or more (considered individually)
for_good: for a long time without essential change
for_good_measure: in addition (as to close a deal)
for_keeps: for the winner to keep all
for_one: as a particular one of several possibilities
for_that_matter: as far as that is concerned
for_the_asking: on the occasion of a request
forbiddingly: in an unpleasant or menacing manner
forever: for a very long or seemingly endless time
forgivably: in an excusable manner or to an excusable degree
forrad: at or to or toward the front
forrard: at or to or toward the front
forsooth: an archaic word originally meaning `in truth' but now usually used to express disbelief
forwards: at or to or toward the front
foully: in an unfair and insulting manner
in a wicked and shameful manner
